# Team Bath Racing Electric

> Team Bath Racing Electric (TBRe) is a student-run Formula Student team at the University of Bath that designs, builds, and races a fully electric single-seater racing car.

Formula Student is the world's largest student engineering competition, and TBRe has competed as an electric team since 2015, racing at Silverstone and internationally.

- [First Place at Formula Student Germany](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/blog-post-1): Our team's journey to victory at one of Europe's most prestigious competitions...

- [The Future of Electric Racing](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/blog-post-3): How our team is pushing the boundaries of electric vehicle technology in motorsport...
- [Official 2016/17 Project Launch](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/2016-10-project-launch): We presented our 2017 plans to around 70 students from across the university and inaugurated our brand-new build room.
- [Recruiting on Campus for TBRe17](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/2016-09-recruitment-campus): TBRe's core members returned to Bath to promote the team during Fresher's week, showcasing TBRe16 outside the library.
- [TBRe16 Goes to FSUK at Silverstone](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/2016-07-fsuk-silverstone): After months of work and many sleepless nights, TBRe16 made it to Silverstone for Formula Student UK.
- [TBRe16's First Rolling Test](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/2016-05-first-rolling-test): A bare chassis, an empty car park and a driver — the ingredients for TBRe16's first rolling test at the University of Bath.
- [Building an Electric Go-Kart](https://teambathracingelectric.com/blog/2016-01-electric-go-kart): Where it all began — converting a petrol go-kart to electric to learn the powertrain before building the real car.
